$comment: Networks this project served once and serves no more — SPEC.md §15.1.
Deleting a city's configuration takes it out of the catalogue, and that is
the lever that retires a dead network. It also leaves whoever had chosen it
with nothing to read: their build either still carries the configuration
and keeps serving a feed that is gone, or no longer does and cannot even
name what it lost. Each network withdrawn is therefore listed here, with
the day it went, and tools/build_catalogue.py copies the list into the
catalogue under `withdrawnCities` — a key of its own, beside `cities` and
never inside it, so that a build older than this list, which ignores the
keys it does not know, can never be offered one of these networks again.
A network listed here must have no configuration in config/cities/: the
catalogue refuses to be built otherwise. The names are the ones the
catalogue carried for it, which is what its users last read. No sentence
goes here: the application says what a withdrawal means in its own words,
translated, and the catalogue carries only the fact and its date.
